40022376.author: पदार्थः
40022376.content: प्रस्थाप्य having sent off, तु indeed, सः he, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, भ्रातृभ्याम् with his two brothers, सह with, राघवः Rama, प्रमुमोद rejoiced, सुखी happy, राज्यम् the kingdom, धर्मेण righteously, परिपालयन् ruling.

40022376.author: Translation
40022376.content: Having sent off Shatrughna, Rama, accompanied by his two brothers, happily rejoiced while ruling the kingdom righteously.

40022377.author: पदार्थः
40022377.content: ततः then, कतिपयाहःसु after a few days, वृद्धः an old man, जानपदः a citizen, द्विजः a Brahmin, मृतम् dead, बालम् child, उपादाय having taken, राजद्वारम् to the royal gate, उपागमत् approached.

40022377.author: Translation
40022377.content: Then, after a few days, an old Brahmin citizen, holding his dead child, approached the royal gate.

40022378.author: पदार्थः
40022378.content: रुदन् weeping, बहुविधाः various kinds of, वाचः words, स्नेहदुःखसमन्विताः filled with affection and sorrow, असकृत् repeatedly, पुत्र O son!, पुत्र O son!, इति thus, वाक्यम् words, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40022378.author: Translation
40022378.content: Weeping, he uttered various words filled with affection and sorrow, repeatedly exclaiming, "O son, O son!"

40022379.author: पदार्थः
40022379.content: किम् what, नु indeed, मे by me, दुष्कृतम् evil, कर्म deed, पुरा formerly, देहान्तरे in another body, कृतम् done, यत् that, अहम् I, पुत्रम् son, एकम् only one, त्वाम् you, पश्यामि I see, निधनम् death, गतम् gone to.

40022379.author: Translation
40022379.content: He lamented, "What evil deed did I commit in a previous birth that I now see you, my only son, having met your death?"

40022380.author: पदार्थः
40022380.content: अप्राप्तयौवनं one who has not attained youth, बालं child, पञ्चवर्षसहस्रकम् of five thousand years (age), अकाले untimely, कालम् death, आपन्नं attained, मम my, दुःखाय for sorrow, पुत्रक O son

40022380.author: Translation
40022380.content: The child, though five thousand years old, had not yet reached youth and met an untimely death, causing great sorrow to the speaker.

40022381.author: पदार्थः
40022381.content: अल्पैः in a few, अहोभिः days, निधनं death, गमिष्यामि I shall attain, न no, संशयः doubt, अहं I, च and, जननी mother, च and, एव indeed, तव your, शोकेन by sorrow, पुत्रक O son

40022381.author: Translation
40022381.content: The speaker and the mother will undoubtedly die within a few days due to the grief over the son's death.

40022382.author: पदार्थः
40022382.content: न not, स्मरामि I remember, अनृतं untruth, हि indeed, उक्तं spoken, न not, च and, हिंसां violence, स्मरामि I remember, अहम् I, सर्वेषां of all, प्राणिनां beings, पापं sin, कृतं done, न not, एव indeed, स्मरामि I remember, अहम् I

40022382.author: Translation
40022382.content: The speaker asserts that he does not recall ever speaking an untruth, committing violence, or performing any sin against any living being.

40022383.author: पदार्थः
40022383.content: केन by what, अद्य today, दुष्कृतेन evil deed, अयं this, बालः child, एव indeed, मम my, आत्मजः son, अकृत्वा without performing, पितृकार्याणि filial duties, गतः gone, वैवस्वतक्षयम् to the abode of Yama

40022383.author: Translation
40022383.content: The speaker wonders what sin he committed that his son, still a child, has died without fulfilling his duties to his ancestors.

40022384.author: पदार्थः
40022384.content: न not, ईदृशं such, दृष्टपूर्वं seen before, मे by me, श्रुतं heard, वा or, घोरदर्शनम् terrible sight, मृत्युः death, अप्राप्तकालानां of those whose time has not come, रामस्य Rama's, विषये in the kingdom, यथा as

40022384.author: Translation
40022384.content: The speaker states that he has never before seen or heard of such a terrible sight as the untimely death of those in Rama's kingdom.

40022385.author: पदार्थः
40022385.content: रामस्य Rama's, दुष्कृतं misdeed, किञ्चित् some, महत् great, अस्ति is, न no, संशयः doubt, यथा just as, हि indeed, विषयस्थानां of those living in the kingdom, बालानां of children, मृत्युः death, आगतः has come.

40022385.author: Translation
40022385.content: There is no doubt that Rama has committed some great sin, just as death has come upon the children living in his kingdom.

40022386.author: पदार्थः
40022386.content: न not, हि indeed, अन्यविषयस्थानां of those living in other kingdoms, बालानां of children, मृत्युतः from death, भयम् fear, त्वं you, राजन् O King, जीवयस्व revive, एनं this, बालं child, मृत्युवशं under the sway of death, गतम् gone.

40022386.author: Translation
40022386.content: Indeed, children in other kingdoms do not fear death, so O King, you must revive this child who has fallen under the sway of death.

40022387.author: पदार्थः
40022387.content: राजद्वारि at the king's gate, मरिष्यामि I will die, पत्न्या with my wife, सार्धम् together, अनाथवत् like an orphan, ब्रह्महत्यां the sin of killing a Brahmin, ततः then, राम O Rama, समुपेत्य having incurred, सुखी happy, भव be.

40022387.author: Translation
40022387.content: I will die at the king's gate with my wife, like a helpless person, and then, O Rama, having incurred the sin of killing a Brahmin, you may be happy.

40022388.author: पदार्थः
40022388.content: भ्रातृभिः with brothers, सहितः accompanied, राजन् O King, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, अवाप्स्यसि you will obtain, उषिताः we have lived, स्म (past tense indicator), सुखं happily, राज्ये in the kingdom, तव your, अस्मिन् in this, सुमहाबल O greatly powerful one.

40022388.author: Translation
40022388.content: O King, accompanied by your brothers, you will obtain a long life; O greatly powerful one, we have lived happily in your kingdom until now.

40022389.author: पदार्थः
40022389.content: इदं this, तु but, पतितं has fallen, तस्मात् therefore, तव your, राम O Rama, वशे under control, स्थिताः being, कालस्य of time, वशम् control, आपन्नाः having fallen into, स्वल्पं little, हि indeed, नहि not at all, नः our, सुखम् happiness.

40022389.author: Translation
40022389.content: But this misfortune has now befallen us, O Rama, who are under your control, as we have fallen under the sway of time, and indeed, our happiness is now very little.

40022390.author: पदार्थः
40022390.content: सम्प्रति now, अनाथः helpless, विषयः kingdom, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvakus, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled ones, रामम् Rama, नाथम् as protector, इह here, आसाद्य having obtained, बालान्तकरणम् causing the death of children, ध्रुवम् certainly.

40022390.author: Translation
40022390.content: Now, this kingdom of the great Ikshvakus, having obtained Rama as its protector, is certainly causing the death of children.

40022391.author: पदार्थः
40022391.content: राजदोषैः by the faults of the king, विपद्यन्ते perish, प्रजाः subjects, हि indeed, अविधिपालिताः not protected according to law, असद्वृत्ते when ill-behaved, तु but, नृपतौ when the king, अकाले untimely, म्रियते dies, जनः people.

40022391.author: Translation
40022391.content: Indeed, subjects not protected according to law perish due to the king's faults, and when the king is ill-behaved, people die untimely deaths.

40022392.author: पदार्थः
40022392.content: यद्वा or when, पुरेषु in cities, अयुक्तानि improper acts, जनाः people, जनपदेषु in districts, च and, कुर्वते do, न not, च and, रक्षा protection, अस्ति is, तदा then, कालकृतम् caused by time, भयम् fear.

40022392.author: Translation
40022392.content: Or when people commit improper acts in cities and districts, and there is no protection, then there is fear caused by the times.

40022393.author: पदार्थः
40022393.content: सुव्यक्तम् very clearly, राजदोषः a king's fault, हि indeed, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt, पुरे in the city, जनपदे in the district, च and, अपि also, ततः therefore, बालवधः child-killing, हि indeed, अयम् this.

40022393.author: Translation
40022393.content: It is very clear that there will be no doubt of a king's fault in the city and the district, and therefore, this child-killing is indeed due to that.

40022394.author: पदार्थः
40022394.content: एवम् thus, बहुविधैः of many kinds, वाक्यैः with words, उपरुध्य having importuned, मुहुर्मुहुः repeatedly, राजानम् the king, दुःखसन्तप्तः afflicted with sorrow, सुतम् son, तम् him, उपगूहते embraces.

40022394.author: Translation
40022394.content: Thus, repeatedly importuning the king with various kinds of words, the father, deeply distressed, clasps his son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 73 ।। Thus ends the seventy-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
